evidence.note: כְּדָרְלָעֹמֶר מֶלֶךְ עֵילָם identifies Chedorlaomer by name and gives the land he ruled.
אֶת כְּדָר לָעֹמֶר writes the king’s name in two parts. וְאֶת הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ adds the kings who were with him.

name: כְּדָרְלָעֹמֶר
summary: Genesis 14:1 names Chedorlaomer as king of Elam. The verse gives his title without explaining his name.
